runs.text: In year 37, early winter, morning, at Harum, the winter camp of the Kesh band, Imra was shaping a scraper by striking cutting stone against a lump of heavy yellow stone. Sparks fell on dry moss beside Imra, and the moss began to smoke. Imra blew on the smoking moss, and it caught fire. Imra tried again 3 times that day, and the moss caught fire 2 of those times. Tavu saw it. Before this, the Kesh band kept fire only by carrying embers from camp to camp. Imra believed fire lives inside the heavy yellow stone.

Year 37. Early winter morning. Harum. Winter camp of the Kesh band. Imra was shaping a scraper. Imra struck cutting stone against a lump of heavy yellow stone. Sparks fell on dry moss beside Imra. Moss began to smoke. Imra blew on the smoking moss. Moss caught fire. Imra tried again three times that day. Moss caught fire two of those times. Tavu saw it. Before this, the Kesh band kept fire only by carrying embers from camp to camp. This was the first time anyone in the world made fire by striking stones. Imra believed fire lives inside the heavy yellow stone.

In year 41, during deep winter night, death from cold occurred at Harum, the old winter camp of the Kesh band. Oru, a man of the Kesh band, had broken his leg in a fall in autumn, and after that, Oru could not walk far. Food ran out at Harum, so the Kesh band moved to Ulmeke, a walk of 4 days. The band left Oru behind at Harum with a small fire and 2 strips of dried meat. Sefi was the last to leave him. On his 4th night alone, the fire went out and Oru died of cold. Ten days later, 2 hunters of the band found his body beside the dead fire.

Year 41. Deep winter. Night. Harum. Old winter camp of the Kesh band. Oru, man, 58 years old, of the Kesh band. In autumn, Oru broke his leg in a fall. After that, Oru could not walk far. Food ran out at Harum. Kesh band moved to Ulmeke. Walk of 4 days. The band left Oru behind at Harum. Small fire. 2 strips of dried meat. Sefi was the last to leave Oru. On his 4th night alone, the fire went out. Oru died of cold. 10 days later, 2 hunters of the band found Oru's body beside the dead fire.

In year 52, spring, night, at Sefa, a lake, the Tulo band camped on its shore. Kaya gave birth to a girl in the camp on the shore of Sefa. Anwe and Lisu helped her. The labour lasted most of the night. The girl was small, and she cried at once. This girl is the 2nd child of Kaya. The first child, a boy, is 3 years old. The Tulo band believed a child is given a name only after it lives through its first winter.

Year 52. Spring. Night. Sefa, wide water. Tulo band camped on shore. Kaya gave birth. Kaya gave birth to a girl in the camp on the shore of Sefa. Anwe and Lisu helped her. Labour lasted most of the night. The girl was small. She cried at once. She is the 2nd child of Kaya. The first, a boy, is 3 years old. The girl has no name yet. Tulo band believe a child is given a name only after it lives through its first winter.

In year 63, late summer, dusk, Anuk waited for Moro at Teshu, a ford of the river. When Moro came to cross, Anuk killed Moro with a spear thrust to the belly. The spear had a "cutting stone" point. Moro died at the ford before dark. Ishe saw the killing from the far bank. Ishe ran to the Tulo camp and told them. Anuk believed and was sure that Moro killed his brother Pell in the spring.

Year 63. Late summer. Dusk. Teshu. A ford of the river. Anuk waited for Moro at Teshu. Moro came to cross. Anuk killed Moro. Anuk used a spear thrust to the belly. The spear had a cutting stone point. Moro died at the ford before dark. Ishe saw the killing from the far bank. Ishe ran to the Tulo camp. Ishe told them.

In year 70, autumn, the Amaru band, consisting of 26 people, argued for 2 days at Ulmeke, a cliff with dry caves, regarding where to spend the winter. Hesh wanted to go to Kotara, while Nima wanted to stay at Ulmeke. The band split: 11 people went with Hesh to Kotara, and 15 stayed with Nima at Ulmeke. Rafi, the son of Hesh, stayed with Nima. Hesh believed and was sure that the shellfish at Kotara do not run out in winter. Nima believed and was sure that the walk to Kotara is too long for the old and for small children.

Year 70, autumn. Ulmeke, red cliff, dry caves. Amaru band, 26 people. Argued for 2 days. Where to spend winter. Hesh wanted Kotara, salt shore. Nima wanted Ulmeke. Band split. 11 people went with Hesh to Kotara. 15 stayed with Nima at Ulmeke. Rafi, son of Hesh, stayed with Nima. Hesh believed shellfish at Kotara do not run out in winter. Nima believed walk to Kotara is too long for old and small children.

In year 77, late winter, night, Dabo of the Kesh band had a dream. Dabo planned to cross the frozen lake Sefa to hunt on the far shore, as crossing the ice saved a day of walking. The night before, Dabo dreamt that his dead mother Ama stood on the ice, and the ice broke under her. When Dabo woke, Dabo changed his mind and did not cross the ice. Dabo walked around the lake instead, which took him 2 days. That same morning, Pek and Hanu crossed the ice and came back safely. Before the dream, Dabo believed the ice is strong enough to cross. After the dream, Dabo believed but was not sure that the ice will break.

Year 77. Late winter. Night. Sefa, wide water, frozen lake. Dabo planned to cross the frozen lake Sefa to hunt on the far shore. Crossing the ice saves a day of walking. The night before, Dabo dreamt that Ama stood on the ice. Ama stood on the ice. The ice broke under Ama. When Dabo woke, Dabo changed his mind. Dabo did not cross the ice. Dabo walked around the lake instead. That took Dabo 2 days. That same morning, Pek and Hanu crossed the ice. Pek and Hanu came back safely.

In year 118, winter, night, at Harum, the winter camp of the Kesh band, Shana told the story to 14 listeners. Shana told the story Tara-mi. Tara-mi was first told in year 45 by Imra. The old telling stated that Fire lived inside the heavy yellow stone. Imra struck the stone, and fire jumped into the moss. The telling now stated that the sky put fire inside the heavy yellow stone. The first mother struck the stone, and fire jumped into the dry grass. The sky was added as the one who put fire in the stone. The name Imra was lost, and she became the first mother. The moss became dry grass.

Shana told Tara-mi to 14 listeners at Harum. The story is about Tara-mi. Tara-mi was first told in year 45 by Imra. The old telling said fire lived inside the heavy yellow stone. Imra struck the stone. Fire jumped into the moss. Now the sky put fire inside the heavy yellow stone. The first mother struck the stone. Fire jumped into the dry grass. The sky was added. The name Imra was lost. She became the first mother. The moss became dry grass.

In year 90, summer, afternoon, at Ulmeke, the camp of the Amaru band, a storm occurred. A sky-fire struck a lone tall tree on the ridge above the camp. The tree split and burned. No one was hurt. Nima said the sky-fire was a sign that the dead no longer wanted the band at Ulmeke. Seventeen of the twenty people of the Amaru band came to believe her. Three days later, the band left Ulmeke and walked toward Sefa. Nima believed the sky-fire was a sign that the dead no longer want the band at Ulmeke, and seventeen of the twenty people of the Amaru band believed the same.

Year 90. Summer. Afternoon. At Ulmeke. The camp of the Amaru band. A storm. Sky-fire struck a lone tall tree on the ridge above the camp. The tree split. The tree burned. No one was hurt. Nima said the sky-fire was a sign. The dead no longer wanted the band at Ulmeke. Seventeen of the twenty people of the Amaru band came to believe her. Three days later, the band left Ulmeke. The band walked toward Sefa.

In year 95, late autumn, before dawn, seven men of the Kesh band, led by Kelo, attacked the Tulo camp at Sefa, a lake. Kelo killed Gudo with clubs. Rena and Oshi were taken captive and their hands were tied with sinew cord. Rena and Oshi carried the dried meat of the Tulo band to the Kesh camp. The other Tulo people fled into the reeds. Kelo believed the Tulo camp had more dried meat than it needed.

Year 95. Late autumn. Before dawn. Kelo led 7 men of the Kesh band. They attacked the Tulo camp at Sefa. Kelo killed Gudo with clubs. They took Rena and Oshi captive. They tied their hands with sinew cord. Rena and Oshi carried the dried meat of the Tulo band to the Kesh camp. The other Tulo people fled into the reeds. Kelo believed the Tulo camp had more dried meat than it needed.

In year 102, spring, midday, the Kesh band and the Amaru band met at Teshu, a ford of the river. The Kesh band and the Amaru band had no words in common, so they pointed and laid things on the ground. Temo gave 3 lumps of red earth to Yari. Yari gave Temo a string of 12 white shells from Kotara. The two bands camped apart for 1 night and went their separate ways the next morning.

We met at Teshu. Spring. Midday. Kesh band and Amaru band met. No words in common. We pointed. We laid things on the ground. Temo gave Yari three lumps of red earth. Yari gave Temo a string of twelve white shells from Kotara. The two bands camped apart for one night. We went our separate ways the next morning.
